facts.fact: Smart Africa and Zambia's Ministry of Technology and Science convened a Lusaka validation workshop on the Digital Entrepreneurship and Innovation Country Assessment with private sector representatives and entrepreneurs, reviewing the proposed Startup Bill.

facts.fact: Zambia's ministry partnered with Smart Africa on a national workshop under the AEDIB 2.0 programme, per Smart Africa.
The workshop assessed progress on the proposed Startup Bill, per the report.
